The planning sentence for a manuscript

Source: R/bucss-output-helpers.R
planning_sentence.Rd

Turns a bucss_power result into the sentence an author writes in a manuscript's planning or method section: the necessary sample size in its design's unit, the desired power, the assurance, and a clause noting the publication bias and uncertainty correction. This mirrors the results_sentence() helper in the sibling package DMAR.

Usage

planning_sentence(x)

Arguments

x

An object of class bucss_power, as returned by any ss_buc_* function.

Value

A single character string.

Author

Ken Kelley (kkelley@nd.edu)

Examples

result <- ss_buc_independent_t(t_observed = 3, n = c(50, 55),
  assurance = .90)
planning_sentence(result)
#> [1] "A planned study with 1485 participants per group (total N = 2970) attains 80% power with 90% assurance, after correcting the prior study's result for publication bias and uncertainty."
